name: opsdraw-monorepo
description: Architecture-as-code editor: Mermaid text and a visual canvas, kept in sync.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @opsdraw/app && npm run build -w opsdraw-mcp && npm run build -w opsdraw
scripts.test: npm run test -w @opsdraw/core && npm run test -w opsdraw-mcp && npm run test -w opsdraw && npm run test -w @opsdraw/app
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/app && tsc -p packages/mcp && tsc -p packages/cli
